description: Builds three bases, renames one and destroys two, inside the grace period so the only draws are the ones that name a base and the only spending is the construction kernel's. The Datacenter's prerequisite is deliberately unmet: availability is a rule the build dialog enforces, not one add_base does, so the reference builds it and the port must too. Every advance ends on a day boundary or inside a day, so deviation 1 never reaches the comparison.
